private_watchlist.name: TerraPower

No new dated item this week.

private_watchlist.name: X-energy

private_watchlist.name: Kairos Power
private_watchlist.note: No new update this week. Google's corporate agreement for a US SMR fleet remains up to 500 MW across 6-7 units, targeting a first commercial Hermes unit by 2030 and full fleet by 2035; the Hermes 2 demonstration plant at Oak Ridge continues construction.

private_watchlist.name: Commonwealth Fusion
private_watchlist.note: Signed a letter of intent for up to $85M from the Commerce CHIPS R&D Office (reported Oct 30) for silicon-carbide magnet power electronics, solid-state RF plasma heating and a SPARC digital twin — one of four LOIs totalling up to $389M. SPARC remains targeted for a 2027 Q>1 run; total capital raised about $4B.

private_watchlist.name: Helion
private_watchlist.note: Its Commerce CHIPS letter of intent for up to $175M (with $50M private matching; Commerce would take a $175M non-voting stake on a definitive award) was reaffirmed in the Oct 30 round of four LOIs. Reports of OpenAI talks for up to 5GW by 2030 sit alongside the Microsoft PPA (50MW by 2029 via the Orion plant).

private_watchlist.name: Holtec Nuclear
private_watchlist.note: No new update this week. The ~$900M Nasdaq listing (HNUC) remains suspended since Sep 16 with no new pricing date; the S-1 stays on file. The underlying business is unchanged: $564M trailing revenue anchored by the Palisades restart and the SMR-300 programme.

bear_case.title: Even the "safe" uranium name just missed
bear_case.description: Cameco's Q3 (Oct 29-30) was an adjusted loss of C$2M with production down 20%, cash cost per pound up 62% and operating cash flow of C$3M; the stock fell ~8-10% to a new low of $76.91 at still ~45-50x forward earnings. Counter: the Key Lake shutdown is planned maintenance, 28M lb a year is contracted through 2030 and long-term uranium is $96.50.

bear_case.title: The whole SMR group keeps making new lows
bear_case.description: Oklo ($25.25) closed at a new 52-week low on Oct 30, and NuScale (~$5.6-6.1), Centrus (~$106) and X-energy ($11.54) sit near their lows despite a licence milestone, the Amazon/AEP Indiana plan and a firm long-term uranium price. B. Riley notes its nuclear/uranium basket is down ~43% on average since Aug 14, citing high-beta de-risking and elevated rates. Counter: drawdowns this size reset entry prices and the selling looks rate-driven.

bear_case.title: Dilution is the real funding model
bear_case.description: Oklo's ~$1B ATM (about a fifth of the company), NuScale's $750M ATM and Centrus's $500M offering mean each upbeat announcement can be financed by selling stock into it; Oklo alone is projected to burn ~$6.5B before 2030 against $3.0B in cash. Counter: raising capital is how pre-revenue builders fund long-lead projects.

bear_case.title: Analysts are capitulating on targets
bear_case.description: Oklo targets were cut by Piper, Barclays, Citi, Truist and B. Riley in two weeks; Centrus by JPMorgan, UBS, Roth, Barclays and Truist; NuScale was cut to Underweight/Sell. Counter: sell-side cuts often arrive near lows, and consensus remains Buy on most names.

bear_case.title: A manufacturing contract or a permit is not an operating reactor
bear_case.description: NuScale's Doosan deal has no disclosed value or customer, Q2 revenue was $75K, there is still no binding module order, X-energy's 960 MW Indiana plan has no final investment decision, and there are zero commercial SMRs operating. Counter: TerraPower is already building Natrium and TVA is moving ahead.

bear_case.title: Hyperscaler and federal money is going to old reactors, not new designs
bear_case.description: Google's 890 MW, Amazon's 690 MW and the Oct 27 conditional $5B DOE loan all support Constellation's existing fleet and uprates, with new capacity only in the 2028-2032 window — favouring operators over pre-revenue SMR developers, while gas and renewables remain faster to build.
